recipes.clipped-text: Give the container min-width:0 / allow wrapping, or make truncation deliberate with text-overflow:ellipsis and -webkit-line-clamp.
recipes.interactive-overlap: Separate the controls: fix the grid/flow so hit areas do not intersect; tighten negative margins.
recipes.occluded-content: Raise or resize the covering element; re-check z-index/stacking and remove stray overlays.
recipes.offscreen-essential: Return the anchored element into the layout flow (remove absolute offsets outside the document).
recipes.scroll-trap: Restore root scrolling (html/body overflow) or make the content fit the viewport.
recipes.content-missing: Render the declared handoff copy for this state before verification.
recipes.spacing-drift: Snap sibling gaps to tokens.spacing (within 1px) or adjust the token scale.
recipes.alignment-drift: Flush stacked siblings that share a left edge (within 2px).
recipes.baseline-drift: Review the geometry change against the last accepted baseline; accept with --accept-baseline when intended.
recipes.position-drift: Move the element back near the spec position (uniform scale, y relative to its region anchor).
recipes.size-drift: Match the spec box within 15% after viewport scaling.
recipes.typography-drift: Use the spec font-size role for this element (within 15%).
recipes.color-token-mismatch: Use the nearest approved roleColors token instead of an off-palette color.
recipes.text-mismatch: Render the spec text for this state.
recipes.ordering-violation: Restore the spec order of the matched pair in the DOM.
recipes.anchor-missing: Add data-ce-el for the spec anchor in the implementation (or drop it from the spec).
recipes.region-missing: Implement the required region with a data-ce-el anchor.
recipes.region-overlap: Separate the required regions so their boxes do not intersect.
recipes.layout-assertion: Fix the spatial relation named in the handoff layout assertion.
